title: Automated Financial Document Reconciliation
business: Financial auditing firms managing high-volume client document processing.
problem: Manual verification of client-submitted financial statements is slow, error-prone, and risks exposing sensitive host-system files to unauthorized scripts.
solution: Use a SandboxAgent with a constrained filesystem to isolate document processing. The agent uses filesystem tools to read client files, perform calculations, and generate reconciliation reports within a temporary, isolated workspace.
steps: Define a SandboxAgent with a Manifest that mounts the specific client document directory as a read-only workspace.
Configure the agent capabilities to include Filesystem access for reading statements and Shell access for running validation scripts.
Initialize a DockerSandboxClient to ensure that all agent-executed code runs within a containerized, OS-isolated environment.
Execute the agent using a SandboxRunConfig that points to the client-specific snapshot for consistent processing.
Verify the output artifacts generated in the sandbox workspace before promoting them to the firm's primary storage.
outcome: Secure, reproducible document processing where the agent operates on isolated data without risking host-system integrity.
limitation: The sandbox session does not provide inherent OS-level confinement when using the UnixLocalSandboxClient; developers must choose a Docker or hosted backend to ensure true process isolation.

diagram.title: Sandbox Execution Workflow
diagram.description: The flow shows how the agent definition and configuration interact with the sandbox environment.

code.content:
from agents import SandboxAgent, DockerSandboxClient

# Define the agent with filesystem capabilities
agent = SandboxAgent(
    name="ReconciliationAgent",
    capabilities=[Filesystem(), Shell()] # Allows file edits and shell commands
)

# Configure the run to use Docker for isolation
config = SandboxRunConfig(client=DockerSandboxClient())
code.explanation: This code initializes a SandboxAgent with necessary capabilities and selects a Docker backend, which maps to the solution of using isolated environments for financial document processing.
